items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release approvals and provenance, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, permit only bounded reversible changes that preserve existing consent, disclosures, data handling, provenance, and claims boundaries, and continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix without credential access, permission changes, dependency additions, deployments, exploitation, or external outreach.
